info.name: OpenG2P Aggregation Layer - Staff search (tab-wise)
info.description:
Registry staff look a beneficiary up across every registry with a `staff_api` in the catalog (`agg_url`, default http://localhost:8110). No consent, consent object or OTP: the staff user's role is checked by this service, and each registry's staff-api checks this service's own service account.

## Two calls, tabs on demand

```
1. POST /aggregation/v1/staff/registry/search   {foundationalId, registryFilter?, purpose?}
   -> per registry: found / not_found / error
      per record: summary (the registry's list row) + tabs, each with the request that opens it
2. POST /aggregation/v1/staff/registry/tab      the tab's request.body, as the search gave it
   -> that tab only: sections (label, fields, isList) with their rows, list sections paged
```

Tabs, sections and fields are the registries' own metadata: a tab added in a registry appears in the search answer without a change here. A client renders what it gets and ignores fields it does not know (`schemaVersion` "1").

A tab request is accepted only for a record its search returned, from the staff user who ran it, until `expiresAt` (then `410 search_expired`: search again). `searchId` is a signed ticket (a long token, not a stored row): it carries the staff user, the records found and the expiry, so nothing is stored and any pod can answer a tab request. Every search and every tab opened is written to the audit log (logger `app.audit`, events `staff_search` / `staff_tab_view`).

## Running it

1. Set `staff_username` / `staff_password` (collection variables, or import `OpenG2P-Aggregator-Staff.postman_environment.json` and fill every value). The user needs a role from `AGGREGATION_LAYER_STAFF_SEARCH_ROLES`. Local stack: `staff`, with the password from your local setup.
2. Run the folders in order. **1 Search** saves `{{search_id}}` and the record ids the tab folders use.

| Folder | What |
|---|---|
| 0 Login | staff token |
| 1 Search | all registries, then each registry alone |
| 2-4 | every tab of each registry, one request per tab (tab ids of the reference registries) |
| 5 | every tab the search returned, sent as given: no tab id written in the collection |
| 6 | paging a list section |
| 7 | refusals |

```bash
newman run postman/OpenG2P-Aggregator-Staff.postman_collection.json \
  --env-var staff_username=staff --env-var staff_password=<password>
```

item.description: What a client does: send each tab's `request.body` exactly as the search gave it. No tab id is written here; this request loops over the tabs saved by **1 Search / All registries** (run the folder, or the whole collection, in the Runner / Newman).

request.description: Sends the next saved tab request; repeats until none is left.

item.name: 6 Paging a list section
item.description: List sections answer page by page: `page` (1-based) and `pageSize` (default and cap set by the service: `AGGREGATION_LAYER_STAFF_TAB_PAGE_SIZE` / `_MAX_PAGE_SIZE`).

request.description: Tab `cropsown_planning_tab` of the record saved by the search (`{{cropsown_cropsown_record_id}}`).

exec: pm.test('one tab: sections with fields and records', () => {
console.log(j.tabId, j.sections.map(s => (s.label || s.sectionId) + ': ' + s.records.length + ' row(s), ' + s.fields.length + ' field(s)').join(' | '));
pm.test('list sections paged by 1', () => j.sections.filter(s => s.isList).forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.pagination.pageSize).to.equal(1); pm.expect(s.records.length).to.be.at.most(1); }));

item.name: 7 Guard rails
Record the search did not return - 400

request.description: A tab request is accepted only for a record its search returned.
Not an active tab of the register (or listed in the catalog's `staff_api.hidden_tabs`).
A record id of one registry sent with another registry's code.
A searchId that is not a ticket this service signed. Also the answer for another staff user's search. After `AGGREGATION_LAYER_STAFF_SEARCH_TTL_SEC` the answer is `410 search_expired`: search again.
A registry code without a `staff_api` in the catalog.
Both routes need a staff token.

item.description: Refusals. Folder 1 must have run (they use its `{{search_id}}` and saved ids).
